name: one. digit. off
source:
"But if I don't like most of your answers, well...."

As the fog rolls in, you attempt to call your brother to let him know you'd be arriving late. However, a simple misdial of one digit directs your phone call to someone you don't know.

Wrong number. No big deal, right?

That is, until the mysterious woman on the other end holds your call hostage with a series of nonsensical questions.

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/one-digit-off]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“但如果我不喜欢你的大部分答案，那么……”

当大雾弥漫时，你试图打电话给你的兄弟，让他知道你会迟到。然而，一个简单的误拨一位数字就会将你的电话转接给你不认识的人。

号码错误。没什么大不了的，对吧？

也就是说，直到另一端的神秘女人用一系列无意义的问题来劫持你的电话。

[来自[url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/one-digit-off]Itch.io[/url]]
